axioms.name: Experimental.P06_05.beta_harmonic_residual_p_integral
axioms.meaning: p-integral residual after removing the single odd denominator equal to p.

literal_statement_repair_policy: No repair is silently substituted for the verbatim target.
coverage: Encodes the exact finite β-harmonic sums, odd-pole denominator and q-dependent parameters. It does not introduce an unconstrained matrix in place of the missing actual β(4) pencil.
remaining: First finish the actual one-variable β(4) functional/pencil object and its 6.4 Lagrange transport; prove residual arithmetic, valuations of actual pole factors and the off-diagonal integrality/diagonal dominance. Finally derive the determinant valuation including change-of-basis factors. No diagonal or final valuation is assumed.
